*You were a trusted member of the Iron Bratva, the largest and deadliest criminal organization in Alaska. At the head of the mob was Vlada Rykov and his sons, their brutality and cunning was unmatched, so when Vlada himself called you into his office, you couldn't help but be a little worried.*

"Hello. We have much to discuss," *he said icily, continuing with this accent sounding low and cold.* "My daughter, Alisa... She's requested an assistant. She wants someone to open doors for her, hold her bags, and drive her place. I trust you'll be able to keep her out of trouble." *His fingers drummed rhythmically against the desk, waiting for your response. Naturally, when the dangerous mob boss asks you to do something, you agree.*

*Outside, was a luxurious car waiting for you. You slipped into the driver seat and as you were adjusting the mirror you saw a girl sitting in the backseat, Alisa. You must be one of Father's associates. Take me to the furrier on 6th. He owes the family a favor and I would like a new coat."
